# JWillum products

> Small offline browser tools that turn CSV exports from Stripe, QuickBooks, Xero, Shopify, Etsy, Faire, Whatnot, Bandcamp, Toggl, Clockify and Harvest into clean files. Every tool is $8 one-time on Gumroad, runs locally in the browser, and needs no account, no subscription and no upload.

- Website: https://jwillumproducts.github.io/
- Store: https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/
- Contact: jwillum.products@gmail.com
- The tools do not sync with Shopify, QuickBooks or Xero; they create files you import yourself.
- Independent; not affiliated with Stripe, Shopify, Intuit, Xero, Etsy, Faire, Whatnot, Bandcamp, Toggl, Clockify or Harvest.
- Refunds: see each product page on Gumroad for its refund policy.

## Payments & bookkeeping

- [StripeClear Journal](https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/stripeclear-journal): Turn a Stripe Balance Transactions CSV into a balanced QuickBooks Online journal CSV, plus a payout summary and an audit file. $8 one-time.
- [BooksExport Clean](https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/books-export-clean): Clean QuickBooks Online or Xero export CSVs for accountant handoff: junk rows stripped, ISO dates and normalized amounts. Not tax advice. $8 one-time.
- [Tracker Invoice Lines](https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/tracker-invoice-lines): Turn a Toggl, Clockify or Harvest detailed time CSV into Xero, Wave or generic Qty × Rate invoice line CSVs. $8 one-time.
- [Bandcamp Sales Clean](https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/bandcamp-sales-clean): Turn your Bandcamp raw sales report CSV into Wave, Xero Bank Statement and generic P&L line CSVs, with optional artist splits. $8 one-time.

## Shopify & Etsy

- [Shopify CSV Densifier](https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/shopify-csv-densifier): Fill the blank order-level cells in a Shopify Orders CSV, then trim it to Pick, Pack or 3PL column presets. $8 one-time.
- [Shopify Customers MailMerge](https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/shopify-customers-mailmerge): Turn a Shopify Customers CSV into clean US, UK, CA, AU or generic mail-merge address columns. $8 one-time.
- [Etsy Listing CSV Fixer](https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/etsy-listing-csv-fixer): Validate and safely clean Etsy listing export CSVs, then download a cleaned file and an issue report. $8 one-time.

## Marketplace fees & profit

- [Faire Wholesale Fee & Profit Calculator](https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/faire-profit-calculator): See what you keep on Faire: compare Marketplace and Direct orders, the new-retailer fee and payout speed, with bulk CSV and break-even pricing. $8 one-time.
- [Whatnot Seller Profit Calculator](https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/whatnot-profit-calculator): See what you keep on Whatnot after category commission and payment processing, with bulk CSV and a show-night print sheet. $8 one-time.

## Events

- [Event QR Badges](https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/event-qr-badges): Turn an attendee CSV into printable Avery 5395-compatible name badges and fold-up table tents with vCard QR codes. $8 one-time.
